# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Verify actual sanitizer instrumentation and run baseline/candidate source lints."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'
WT = G / '.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013'
P = B / 'main-prefill-native-copy-queue-source-v2'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('native_copy_host_review_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
build_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-build-root-v1/record.json'
build = json.loads(build_path.read_text())
assert build['passed'] and build['complete'] and not build['active']
assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in build['commands'])
ENV = build['environment']


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-host-review-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={}, main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, build_receipt_path=str(build_path),
             build_receipt_sha256=m.sha(build_path), lints_qualified=False)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, cwd=WT, env=None, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED HOST REVIEW ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env or ENV, cwd, wall=900, cpu=7200,
                             rss_cap=16 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        stdout, stderr = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return stdout, stderr, c

    try:
        for path, digest in build['source_pins'].items():
            assert m.sha(WT / path) == digest
        commands = json.loads((WT / 'build/free-asan/compile_commands.json').read_text())
        r['actual_sanitizer_compile_commands'] = [entry for entry in commands if Path(entry['file']).name in
                                                  ['test_copy_stream_policy.cpp', 'test_native_copy_lifetime.cpp']]
        assert len(r['actual_sanitizer_compile_commands']) == 2
        for entry in r['actual_sanitizer_compile_commands']:
            assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in entry['command'] and '-DNDEBUG' in entry['command']
        r['sanitizer_symbol_evidence'] = {}
        for name in ['copy_stream_policy_test', 'native_copy_lifetime_test']:
            stdout, _, _ = run('asan-symbols-' + name, ['/usr/bin/nm', str(WT / 'build/free-asan' / name)])
            r['sanitizer_symbol_evidence'][name] = [line for line in stdout.splitlines() if '__asan_init' in line or '__ubsan_handle' in line]
            assert any('__asan_init' in line for line in r['sanitizer_symbol_evidence'][name])
        assert any('__ubsan_handle' in line for lines in r['sanitizer_symbol_evidence'].values() for line in lines)
        r['actual_host_asan_ubsan_instrumentation_proved'] = True
        # Same compiler/flags, untouched source and headers for the before lint.
        before_config = next(c['argv'] for c in build['commands'] if c['label'] == 'configure-free')
        baseline_folder = W / 'build/lint-native-copy-baseline'
        argv = [str(W) if arg == str(WT) else str(baseline_folder) if arg == str(WT / 'build/free') else arg
                for arg in before_config]
        run('configure-untouched-lint-baseline', argv, W)
        manifest = json.loads((P / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        before = [entry['path'] for entry in manifest['source_files'] if entry['before_sha256']]
        after = [entry['path'] for entry in manifest['source_files']]
        if not (WT / '.lint').exists():
            (WT / '.lint').symlink_to('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
        before_env = dict(ENV, STRATA_LINT_BUILD=str(baseline_folder))
        stdout, stderr, old = run('baseline-source-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *before], W,
                                 before_env, (0, 1))
        assert 'skipped (' not in stdout + stderr
        current_env = dict(ENV, STRATA_LINT_BUILD=str(WT / 'build/free'))
        stdout, stderr, new = run('candidate-source-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *after], WT,
                                 current_env, (0, 1))
        assert 'skipped (' not in stdout + stderr
        r.update(baseline_lint_exit=old['exit_code'], candidate_lint_exit=new['exit_code'])
        if new['exit_code'] != 0:
            raise RuntimeError('Candidate lint findings require Main baseline comparison or correction; no runtime admission.')
        run('source-diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, lints_qualified=True, no_new_findings=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'baseline_lint_exit', 'candidate_lint_exit',
                                           'actual_host_asan_ubsan_instrumentation_proved', 'lints_qualified']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
